hypothesis: Quantify disagreement between cached RGB and sampled-cell memberships and sensitivity of fixed CONCH morphology scores to remaining comparison support.
selection: Largest mapped component per topology; ties resolve by original tile indices, never scores or annotation. Nested original-context permutation prefixes per seed. Full context scores reused; unavailable target sizes remain excluded.
topology: Original cached 220/10 RGB memberships versus recorded-grid 8-neighbor occupied cells with zero missing-cell bridges; compare only, never choose a rule.
context_support: Empty=0, singleton=1, partial-NN5=2..5, full-NN5>=6 outside tiles; background references exclude self. Majority means >half the sampled bag, not a foreignness cutoff.
authorization_basis: User requested next after S3 topology/context audit recommendation; bounded original-development CPU research, no GPU/download/held-out evaluation.
limitations: Training only; no held-out calibration/test or evaluated fresh60 arrays opened
Cached development case catalog includes known calibration records, filtered to training before measurement; contains no test cases
RGB masks and sampled components are proxies, not pathologist verified physical pieces
Unassigned RGB tiles remain unassigned and in outside context, never merged into guessed pieces
Reference subsampling changes observed context support/composition, not biological tissue or contamination
Seeds and context sizes repeat the same native slides; duplicate subsets are identified, not independent samples
No classifier calls, foreign detection estimates, policy choice, threshold fit, or final-test readiness
Annotation information joins only after feature construction for native positive/unknown-control accounting
